data.summary: Hausverwaltung Beispieldach & Partner, the property manager for Quellenweg 7, writes that only part of the November 2026 rent was received and that the 2025 operating-cost back-payment from September is still unpaid, totaling €526.42, and asks for payment by 7 December 2026.
data.explanation: Your property manager notes two unpaid amounts on your rent account: part of November's rent and the leftover balance from your 2025 operating-cost statement, together €526.42. They ask you to transfer this by the deadline shown. If you are short on money, the letter says you can contact them to arrange installments (Ratenvereinbarung) instead of just missing the deadline. If you do nothing, further reminders, late-payment charges, or in a worst case termination proceedings could follow, though none of that is threatened in this letter yet. Pay promptly or reach out to agree on a payment plan.
